recentDecisions.decision: v4.0 MAJOR PIVOT: Professional Trading Terminal replaces Hypnotic Purple & Gold
recentDecisions.rationale: Production feedback: purple/gold looked childlike, not professional. Bloomberg aesthetic = trust. Pre-made Avatar IV = better lip-sync. Voice Director = dynamic tonation.
alternatives: Keep v3.0 Hypnotic Purple & Gold style

recentDecisions.decision: Color palette: Navy #1a3a52 (50-60%), Green #2d9d4a (20-30%), Gold #d4af37 (10-15% accent)
recentDecisions.rationale: Bloomberg-inspired. Navy=trust, Green=growth+Islamic finance, Gold=premium accent. Red banned. Purple banned as primary.

recentDecisions.decision: Pre-made Avatar IV (Professional tab) replaces custom avatars
recentDecisions.rationale: Avatar IV has superior cross-language lip-sync (175+ languages), micro-expressions. Natural language description, no avatar_id.

recentDecisions.decision: Voice Director + Voice Mirroring for dynamic tonation (HeyGen does NOT support SSML)
recentDecisions.rationale: Per-scene emotion control: Excited, Calm, Serious, Urgent. Soccer-announcer energy at peaks, whispering for secrets.

recentDecisions.decision: CTA tunnel structure: Hook→Problem→Solution→Tension→CTA at peak desire
recentDecisions.rationale: Video funnels toward CTA moment. Green button + gold accent. Arabic identity-affirming language.

established: One sentence = One scene (1-3s pacing)
Pre-made Avatar IV: 2-3s flash shots (30-40% max screen time)
Navy #1a3a52 + Green #2d9d4a + Gold #d4af37 accent, NEVER red, NEVER purple as primary
Bloomberg Trading Terminal aesthetic — professional data viz, animated candlesticks
CTA: Green button + gold accent, tunnel structure (Hook→Problem→Solution→Tension→CTA)
60-70% B-roll / 30-40% A-roll ratio
Smooth flowing transitions — NO hard cuts, NO crossfades, NO silence between scenes
9 sentences = 9 scenes = ~30 seconds
Trading-specific asset language: candlestick formation, data stream, trading dashboard
Voice Director per-scene: Excited/Calm/Serious/Urgent/Whisper
3-layer audio: voiceover (0dB) + music (-12dB continuous) + SFX (-10dB)
Explicit ban on emoji/clipart/flat2D in every prompt
Every frame has continuous motion — nothing static
Charts = animated candlesticks with green/white candles on dark navy
ZERO English on screen — numbers in Arabic digits too
Avatar = platform limitation (medium shot only), vary overlays
Duration cap + NO silence gaps + trim dead air
CTA = 5-6s dedicated scene, avatar finishes before ending
Voice Mirroring option for peak emotion lines
Brand colors ONLY even for negative concepts — charcoal/navy for negatives
toAvoid: Purple as primary color — childlike, gaming aesthetic
Red color anywhere — loss/danger/stop in finance
Monotone voice — must vary emotion per scene via Voice Director
Hard cuts between scenes — use flowing transitions
Silence between scenes — continuous audio flow
English text on screen — ALL text must be Arabic
Flat 2D charts — must be animated candlesticks on dark backgrounds
Generic avatar camera terms — HeyGen ignores these
CTA scene under 5s — avatar speech gets cut off
Static B-roll — every frame needs motion
Flash cuts language — HeyGen interprets as hard cuts
Custom avatar upload — pre-made Avatar IV has better lip-sync
